system.target: Caster, or nearby Terrestrial Circle sorcery spell
system.description:
This spell has special timing rules. The character can cast it as a reflexive Shape Terrestrial Circle Sorcery action that takes 0 ticks. It follows all other rules for sorcery actions, and the character must take a Cast Sorcery action as their next normal action.

The sorcerer may protect herself, wrapping her in warding essence until her next action. Terrestrial Circle spells targeted against her unravel on contact, but the effort imposes a -2 internal penalty on all physical actions until the countermagic fades. Alternatively, she may project the effect outward, disrupting any Terrestrial Circle spell currently in progress within a number of yards equal to (Essence x 50). Countermagic cannot banish demons, though it can destroy other active sorcerous effects. Some spells can be countered after casting if so noted in their description.
